verdict.rationale: Sumsub's "Summy AI" produces AI-generated applicant overviews (status, rejection reasons, next steps) directly from verification data, and Sumsub also ships AI-powered anomaly detection for transaction data, both of which are in-product AI insight/suggestion features rather than external tools. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Summy AI's output quality and broader coverage of AI-generated suggestions across all data types (documents, AML, etc.), not just applicant status.
